file_id: Unknown vs Beli Ram Sharma And Others on 1 January, 2020

sentences.text: Unknown vs Beli Ram Sharma And Others on 1 January, 2020

Author: Vivek Singh Thakur
Bench: Vivek Singh Thakur
Cr.MMO No. 225 of 2019 .
01.01.2020
Present: Mr. Janesh Gupta, Advocate, for the petitioner.

Mr. S.C. Sharma, Additional Advocate General, with M/s R.P. Singh, Kuldeep Chand Thakur &
Ms.Seema Sharma, Deputy Advocate Generals, for respondent No.1.
Mr. Y.P. Sood, Advocate, for respondents No.2 and 3.
Mr. Balwant Kukreja, Advocate, for respondent No.4.

On first date of hearing, in Cr.M.P. No. 629 of 2019 interim stay was granted till next date of hearing and further proceedings in Complaint No. 291-3/04 of 2003 renumbered as Food Act/9005384/2004 titled as State of H.P. vs. Beli Ram Sharma and others,
pending in the Court of learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Court No.2, Shimla, were ordered to be stayed, but thereafter, this application was not listed.

entities.text: State of H.P. vs. Beli Ram Sharma and others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Court No.2, Shimla
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Neither independent reply to this application was filed nor this application was listed ever till date.

During pendency of present petition, petitioner has approached the Additional Chief Secretary (Health) to the Government of Himachal Pradesh, for closing proceedings, but its representation has been rejected and thereafter, petitioner has approached the Commissioner by invoking provisions of Food Safety and Standards Act, which is pending adjudication.

In aforesaid facts and circumstances, it would be appropriate to continue interim order dated 26.04.2019 passed in Cr.M.P. No. 629 of 2019 till next date of hearing with direction to the petitioner to take steps to expedite hearing in the appeal before the Commissioner, otherwise matter may be heard without waiting for decision of the .
Commissioner in the appeal/representation preferred by the petitioner.
Reply, if any, be filed within four weeks.

January 1, 2020 (Purohit) to (Vivek Singh Thakur) Judge Unknown vs Beli Ram Sharma And Others on 1 January, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/106914119/
